description: This Java source file defines the CategoryDBUtil class which provides database utility methods for managing Category entities, including retrieving, inserting, updating, and deleting categories from the database.

classes.name: CategoryDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class for performing database operations related to categories in the grocery ordering system.

methods.name: getAllCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all category records from the database and returns them as a list of Category objects.

methods.name: insertCategory
methods.description: Inserts a new category into the database and associates it with an employee ID.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing category identified by its CID.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category from the database based on its CID.
